.github/workflows/ci.yml: The CI workflow: rules checks and the three package test jobs plus the cross-package suite job.
scripts/checks/code-files.mjs: Classifies code and test paths and lists repo code files via git.
scripts/checks/count-lines.mjs: Counts lines in source text without adding a line for a trailing newline.
scripts/checks/file-size.mjs: Parses the legacy-oversize list and checks file line counts against the 450-line limit.
scripts/checks/legacy-ratchet.mjs: Rejects legacy-oversize list entries that were added or raised compared with the base list, and decides which base lists are acceptable.
scripts/checks/no-tracked-deps.mjs: Fails if git tracks any file, folder or symlink whose path has a node_modules segment.
scripts/checks/nul-check.mjs: Reports a NUL byte found in a text file.
scripts/checks/package-scope.mjs: Checks that the root package.json is an ES module and no nested package.json exists outside packages/.
scripts/checks/package-test-globs.mjs: Fails when a package test file (by Node default test names) is not run by the files its npm test really passes to node --test.
scripts/checks/run-size-check.mjs: CLI that checks repo file sizes or writes the legacy-oversize allowlist.
scripts/checks/test-command-args.mjs: Evaluates a node --test command with the shell and returns the test paths and globs it passes, without Node options.
scripts/ci/choose-base.sh: Chooses the base commits (one per line) for the CI diff and legacy-list ratchet: every parent that has the list, with the import-commit fallback only before the list exists.
scripts/ci/suite-tests.sh: Runs Story Block's whole suite with the sibling packages present plus root tests/suite, failing on unlisted skips, extra todos or a test count below the floor.
scripts/codemap/build-map.mjs: Builds sorted codemap rows and validates jobs and export limits; a legacy package lists over-limit files as a backlog.
scripts/codemap/cli.mjs: CLI that writes or verifies docs/codemap.md and the package maps under docs/codemap/ from source files and job files.
scripts/codemap/dev-map-jobs.mjs: Reads a package's hand-written docs/dev/codemap.md bullets into package-relative job sentences.
scripts/codemap/export-names.mjs: Lists the names a file exports, expanding wildcard re-exports through internal files and reporting unresolved ones.
scripts/codemap/find-commonjs.mjs: Finds any use of the names module or exports, which are reserved because CommonJS cannot be told apart reliably.
scripts/codemap/header-job.mjs: Takes the first sentence of a file's opening comment as its job sentence.
scripts/codemap/is-facade.mjs: Decides whether a file only forwards other modules exports and so is exempt from the export limit.
scripts/codemap/package-features.mjs: Renders a package's feature entry-point index and reports entries that are not files.
scripts/codemap/package-map.mjs: Builds one package's code map: rows with tests, feature index and the one-job-per-file backlog.
scripts/codemap/package-outputs.mjs: Finds each package under the layout's package roots and builds its map from its jobs, dev map and feature files.
scripts/codemap/parse-module.mjs: Extracts exports and import specifiers from ES module source text.
scripts/codemap/pattern-names.mjs: Lists the names a destructuring or plain binding pattern declares.
scripts/codemap/render-map.mjs: Renders codemap rows into a deterministic markdown document.
scripts/codemap/resolve-spec.mjs: Resolves a relative import specifier to a repo file path.
scripts/codemod/apply.mjs: Applies a layout plan to a git tree: moves files, backs up deletes, then runs the import and string rewriters.
scripts/codemod/plan.mjs: Turns tracked files plus rule sets into a move/delete plan and refuses unmatched files, collisions and clobbered targets.
scripts/codemod/port-branch.mjs: Ports a lane branch to the new layout in a temp worktree and merges main so only real conflicts remain.
scripts/codemod/rewrite-imports.mjs: Rewrites a moved file's relative import specifiers: resolved against the old place, written against the new one.
scripts/codemod/rewrite-strings.mjs: Rewrites the non-import path references (codemap keys, lists, CI globs, path literals) from an explicit table of sites.
scripts/codemod/rules.mjs: Reads codemod layout rule files and matches a path to the longest rule prefix with stem handling.
scripts/codemod/specifiers.mjs: Finds every module specifier in a JS source with acorn and resolves a relative one against a file set.
scripts/codemod/verify.mjs: Checks a migrated tree: specifiers resolve, nothing is left at an old location, and the diff is only renames plus path edits.
scripts/dryrun/cli.mjs: CLI that records chat exports against a suite checkout and compares two recording folders.
scripts/dryrun/compare-history.mjs: Lists which history-operation steps of a dry-run recording failed, so a thrown or empty step is never a pass.
scripts/dryrun/compare-records.mjs: Compares two dry-run chat recordings and reports up to 20 truncated differences.
scripts/dryrun/history-ops.mjs: Runs the seeded swipe, middle delete, rewind and reload sequence on one chat and records head hash, queries and Re-read after each.
scripts/dryrun/load-chat.mjs: Loads a SillyTavern .jsonl or .jsonl.gz chat export into header and messages.
scripts/dryrun/out-guard.mjs: Refuses a dry-run output folder inside any git checkout or non-empty, and clears only the files its manifest lists.
scripts/dryrun/prompt-capture.mjs: Runs the host's prompt build for the next reply and returns the static text and tail it sets.
scripts/dryrun/query-args.mjs: Finds real names, ids and owners in the chat state to call the id-taking queries with.
scripts/dryrun/query-steps.mjs: Finds the host's scene, inventory, director and npc queries and asks them at one reply.
scripts/dryrun/record-chat.mjs: Replays a loaded chat on the suite host to record per-reply hashes, prompts, queries, and Re-read results.
scripts/dryrun/reread-step.mjs: Loads a chat into the host, reads a reply's Changes text, and Re-reads one reply on a fresh load.
scripts/dryrun/state-hash.mjs: Stable stringify and hashing of host state so old and new runs compare by bytes.
scripts/dryrun/suite-host.mjs: Builds the suite host with the page's Delta runtime, a checkpoint vault and stand-in restores for exports without dossier files.
scripts/release.mjs: CLI that builds every extension's bundles and runs the release gate (--check builds into a temporary folder).
scripts/release/bundle.mjs: Packs one extension into a few ES-module bundles with source maps, lazy parts kept as separate chunks.
scripts/release/check.mjs: Runs the release gate: version 0.1.0, no tag, each bundle set builds, resolves its imports, keeps import.meta.url rewritten and loads in at most ten requests.
scripts/release/entries.mjs: Lists what the release build packs: the entry files and lazy modules of each extension.
scripts/release/outdir.mjs: Decides where the release build may write: refuses the source and the repo root, and empties only folders carrying its own marker file.
scripts/release/rewrite.mjs: Rewrites a module's source by syntax tree for the bundle: packs eager import() calls and keeps import.meta.url on the module's original location.
scripts/release/graph.mjs: Walks a bundle folder's import graph to list the files of the load, the lazy chunks and any missing import.
scripts/verify-import.sh: Proves the imported package trees match the recorded source snapshots by comparing git tree hashes.
tests/scripts/ci-timeouts.test.js: Checks that every CI job has a timeout and every node --test command sets the per-test timeout and force-exit flags and matches its package script.
tests/suite/nsd-static-part.js: Writes NPC State Delta's own one-pass static prompt key the way its runtime injection does, and switches its adapter on or off for the suite test.
tests/suite/redraw-count.bench.test.js: Pins today's tab-pane redraw and NPC State renderCast counts per reply for the three-module suite (quiet and active scenarios, flag off).
tests/suite/static-prompt.test.js: Pins the whole static prompt of the three-module suite per scenario against the golden and checks it is byte-identical reply to reply.
ui/card/card-icons.js: Draws the card's soak, pace and status glyphs from the mock's shapes, with a shared-set fallback.
ui/card/card-row.js: Builds the card's top row: ‹ Chat, time · place · weather with the mock's glyphs (opens the Scene sheet) and ⚙.
ui/card/character-card.js: Builds the full character card shown on top of every tab, with a Story-only variant when RPG is off.
ui/chat/chat-surfaces.js: Keeps the inline row on the latest reply and the people drawer above the input: moves, hides and folds them as the chat changes.
ui/chat/inline-row.js: Builds the quiet inline row under the latest reply: time, place, weather, money, Needs you, Fight, Choices and the Suite link.
ui/chat/people-drawer.js: Builds the people drawer above the message box: a "Here" header and one page of feelings-ring cards.
ui/chat/reply-menu.js: Builds the "Story Suite: this reply" button for a message's action row and the sheet that lists that reply's changes and its state then.
ui/contract/bag.js: Defines the view-model shape for the Bag tab (items, purse, load, pace, assets).
ui/contract/card.js: Defines the view-model shape for the shared character card.
ui/contract/chat.js: Defines the view-model shape for the chat inline row, people drawer, and reply menu.
ui/contract/dossier.js: Defines the view-model shape for one person's dossier page, including the Death card.
ui/contract/fight.js: Defines the view-model shape for the Fight tab (board state, foes, party strip, actions, log, end).
ui/contract/journal.js: Defines the view-model shape for the Journal tab (quests, calendar, days, coming up).
ui/contract/now.js: Defines the view-model shape for the Now tab.
ui/contract/party.js: Defines the view-model shape for the Party tab (members, sheets, gear slots, skills).
ui/contract/people.js: Defines the view-model shape for the People tab (here, elsewhere, deceased, ties for the map).
ui/contract/settings.js: Defines the view-model shape for the Settings overlay (schema rows, module sets, connections).
ui/contract/shapes.js: Checks a value against a plain shape spec and lists mismatches by path.
ui/contract/story.js: Defines the view-model shape for the Story tab (Director screen and trackers).
ui/contract/world.js: Defines the view-model shape for the World tab (places, routes, trip, news, factions).
ui/css/bag.css: Styles for the Bag tab: Purse and load, Assets, item grid and sheets; tokens only, layout follows the container.
ui/css/base.css: Base styles: reset, font and focus rules for everything inside the suite root.
ui/css/card.css: Character card styles (decisions 19-21): tokens renamed from --g-* to --su-*.
ui/css/chat.css: Inline row and people drawer: SillyTavern theme variables only, never the suite tokens (decision 34).
ui/css/dossier.css: Styles for the dossier: top bar, hero ring, summary cards, pager and the page bodies; tokens only, sized from the container.
ui/css/fight.css: Styles for the Fight tab: header, foes, party, action tiles, log and end card; tokens only, sized from the container.
ui/css/journal.css: Styles for the Journal tab: quest cards, leads, closed list, calendar, day panel, coming up and the edit form; tokens only.
ui/css/kit.css: Kit styles: the one button, chip, switch and segmented-control family, sized for touch.
ui/css/next-hide.css: Hides the old Story Suite furniture in the chat only while the body carries ss-ui-next.
ui/css/now.css: Styles for the Now tab cards, the Show-all list, the spoiler switch and the feelings ring; tokens only.
ui/css/party.css: Party tab styles (decision 22, party.html): member row, sheet, equipment doll, stats, skills and the bottom sheets; tokens only.
ui/css/people.css: Styles for the People tab: tiles, filters, search and the cast map; tokens only.
ui/css/settings.css: Settings overlay styles: frame, section nav, rows and controls, search, footer meter (decision 33; tokens renamed --g-* to --su-*).
ui/css/shell.css: Shell styles: sliding root, dimmed chat, sky backdrop, tab strip, phone bar and mini bar. Layout follows the container, never the viewport.
ui/css/story.css: Styles for the Story tab: plan bar, Director cards, agendas, secrets, ripples and trackers; tokens only.
ui/css/world.css: Styles for the World tab: switch, map, trip card, place sheet, news and factions; tokens only, sized from the container.
ui/dev/harness.html: Dev harness page: the plain HTML shell that loads the suite UI on the fake port for local viewing and the rendered checks.
ui/dev/harness.js: Dev harness: mounts the suite on the fake port with theme, variant and width switches (also driven by the URL query).
ui/dev/portraits.js: Dev harness only: puts the mock's portrait photos on data-portrait elements, keeping the letter circle as the fallback.
ui/entry/flag.js: Reads and writes the ui.next flag in SillyTavern's extension settings, safe when the context has no settings.
ui/entry/switch.js: Draws the "new view (preview)" checkbox row in SillyTavern's extension settings.
ui/entry/turn-on.js: Mounts the new view on the Story Block port (styles, body class, menu entry, chat surfaces, listeners) and returns the function that removes it all.
ui/fixtures/bag.js: Builds the shared Bag fixture: items, purse, load, party pace and assets (default, story-only, over the limit).
ui/fixtures/dossier.js: Shared dossier fixtures (alive, away, deceased, presumed with unknown gender) plus the cast ties for People > Map.
ui/fixtures/fight.js: Builds the shared Fight fixture: the Auvoth bridge fight in each board state (offer, choose, target, ally, after, end).
ui/fixtures/index.js: Builds plain-JSON story-state view-model fixtures and variants (default, rpgOff, fightOpen, empty).
ui/fixtures/journal.js: Builds the Journal tab fixture (quests, leads, closed, calendar, days, coming up) from the shared moment.
ui/fixtures/moment.js: Shared story-state fixture at 9:30 am in the Bluewatch Guild Office, plus the 2:10 pm bridge fight state.
ui/fixtures/party.js: Builds the shared Party fixture: Astra, Brann, Rika and Torka with sheets, gear slots and skills.
ui/fixtures/people.js: Shared cast fixture covering present NPCs, away party/contacts, deceased, dormant, and bridge-fight overrides.
ui/fixtures/settings-extra.js: Settings fixture data beyond plain rows: module definitions, presets, the removed list, packs, trackers and the "what's sent" breakdown.
ui/fixtures/settings-rows.js: Builds every Settings section's schema rows from the approved mock (decision 33), keyed by section id; `R` makes one row.
ui/fixtures/settings.js: Builds the Settings overlay fixture (schema rows per section, module sets, three connections) at code defaults.
ui/fixtures/story.js: Builds the Story tab fixture (plan switch, pulse, arc, agendas, cast, secrets, ripples, trackers) from the shared moment.
ui/fixtures/world.js: Shared world fixtures (map, trip, news, factions) with variants: default, fightOpen (on the road), empty.
ui/index.js: Public face of the new Story Suite view: re-exports the mount function, the port contract and the fake port.
ui/kit/bars.js: Draws the three equal Health, Mana and Stamina bars and the thin EXP bar of the character card.
ui/kit/controls.js: Provides the suite's single control family: button, chip, switch toggle and segmented control.
ui/kit/dom.js: Builds DOM and SVG elements from tag names, attributes and children using text nodes only.
ui/kit/glyphs.js: Provides the suite's SVG glyph set as structured path data and an element builder.
ui/kit/more.js: Shows the first few rows of a list and a "Show all N" / "Show fewer" button for the rest.
ui/kit/page.js: Builds the pager bar for a multi-page screen, plus the page section and label-value list that page bodies share.
ui/kit/ring.js: Draws the feelings ring: four quarter arcs (trust, affection, desire, tension) sized by each meter, none for zero.
ui/kit/sheet.js: Opens the shared bottom sheet (dim backdrop, grab bar, optional title row) that closes by backdrop, Escape or its close button.
ui/kit/spoiler.js: Builds the spoiler switch row and the hidden-until-shown text used for scene secrets.
ui/mount.js: Mounts the suite on a port: builds the shell and tab host, wires back-stack and redraw, and returns open, close and destroy.
ui/port/contract.js: Defines the UI-to-engine port method contract and validates port implementations.
ui/port/fake-port.js: Fake engine port that serves fixture view-models, records commands, and emits events on demand.
ui/port/sb-port.js: Wraps Story Block's sdk as the UI port: views come from injected selectors fed by sdk queries, actions pass through, and nothing throws.
ui/port/st-chat.js: Touches SillyTavern's page: finds message elements, adds the Extensions-menu entry, fills the input, and keeps prefs in chat metadata.
ui/runtime/back-stack.js: Manages the Escape and back stack in order: menu, sheet, page, settings, suite, chat.
ui/runtime/prefs.js: Stores fold state per device and spoiler levels per chat through the port.
ui/runtime/redraw.js: Coalesces change events into one frame and redraws only changed sections.
ui/select/bag.js: Turns the recorded inventory, gear, wallet and mount query answers into the Bag view-model (BAG_SHAPE), leaving gaps null.
ui/select/build.js: Builds the per-tab selector map for the Story Block port from the gathered answers.
ui/select/card.js: Builds the character-card view-model from recorded query answers; gaps come back as null.
ui/select/chat.js: Builds the chat view-models (inline row, people drawer, reply menu lines) from recorded query answers; gaps come back as null or [].
ui/select/dossier.js: Turns the recorded dossier, meters, ladder and notes query answers into one person's Dossier view-model (DOSSIER_SHAPE), leaving gaps null or empty.
ui/select/fight.js: Turns the recorded fight-board snapshot, party and choice lists into the Fight view-model (FIGHT_SHAPE), leaving gaps null.
ui/select/gather.js: Reads the scene answers, portraits and gear from Story Block queries for the selectors.
ui/select/journal.js: Turns recorded Director query answers into the Journal tab view-model (gaps come back null, empty or zero).
ui/select/now.js: Builds the Now-tab view-model from recorded query answers; gaps come back as null or empty lists.
ui/select/party.js: Turns the recorded party and gear query answers into the Party view-model (PARTY_SHAPE), leaving gaps null.
ui/select/people-parts.js: Reads the People tab's parts and the per-person dossier map from Story Block queries.
ui/select/people.js: Turns the recorded NPC, key-people and party query answers into the People view-model (PEOPLE_SHAPE), leaving gaps null or empty.
ui/select/settings.js: Builds the Settings view-model from today's host settings (schema, defaults, stored values) and the feature list; gaps come back empty or null.
ui/select/story.js: Turns recorded Director and data-module query answers into the Story tab view-model (gaps come back null, empty or false).
ui/select/world.js: Builds the World view-model from recorded atlas.view, world.areaTier, atlas.selected and director.world answers (pure).
ui/settings/connections.js: Renders the Models page's three connection cards (Story, Quick helpers, Background) and the "Who goes first" note.
ui/settings/fields.js: Renders one settings schema row (label, hint, marks and the control for its type) and groups rows into cards.
ui/settings/modules.js: Renders the Start page's module area: the scope switch, the three presets and the module cards with their features.
ui/settings/nav.js: Builds the section navigation: a side list with search and group labels, and the phone section list with the same search.
ui/settings/overlay.js: Builds the Settings overlay frame: header, section nav, the section or search page, the "what's sent" footer, and its back-stack entry.
ui/settings/packs.js: Renders the Packs and trackers page: installed packs with a remove confirmation, data modules and this chat's trackers.
ui/settings/page.js: Composes one Settings section page: heading, the "applies to" note, the module card, the special body, the setting cards and the reset buttons.
ui/settings/search.js: Finds settings rows by words across label, hint, unit, group and section name, and renders the hits under "Section › Group".
ui/settings/sections/director.js: Renders the Director section through the hook: the overlay's body for it, unchanged.
ui/settings/sections/index.js: Maps each settings section id to its hook renderer; sections with no entry get the overlay's default body.
ui/settings/sections/look.js: Renders the Look section: the overlay's body plus a note on what Follow SillyTavern does.
ui/settings/sections/money-extras.js: Renders the Money and Chat extras sections through the hook: the overlay's body for each, unchanged.
ui/settings/sections/people.js: Renders the People section through the hook: the overlay's body for it, unchanged.
ui/settings/sections/rpg.js: Renders the RPG and fights section: the overlay's body plus the Custom-difficulty pointer to Director.
ui/settings/sections/start.js: Frames a hook page: the overlay's body for a section with the hook's own notes before or after it.
ui/settings/sections/world.js: Renders the World and time section through the hook: the overlay's body for it, unchanged.
ui/settings/sent.js: Renders the Tools page's "What is sent each reply" card (budget bars and the text sent) and the Inspector and problems card.
ui/sheets/scene-sheet.js: Builds the Scene sheet (date, time, place, weather, who is here) as one hand correction, and opens it in a sheet.
ui/shell/default-views.js: Supplies the default card and tab renderers for mountSuite: the character card, the Now tab, and a "not built yet" card.
ui/shell/suite-view.js: Builds the suite root that slides in over the chat, sized from its container and centred over a dimmed chat on desktop.
ui/shell/tab-host.js: Builds the 8-tab host: tablet strip, phone bottom bar, scrolling panel and the mini bar shown after the card scrolls away.
ui/shell/tab-views.js: Builds the renderer for every built tab (Party, Bag, Fight, People, World, Journal, Story) from a view-model and a shared context.
ui/st-entry.js: Staging entry for the preview extension: waits for Story Block, draws the "new view (preview)" switch, and turns the new view on or off as ui.next changes.
ui/tabs/bag/assets.js: Builds the Assets card (party pace, Transport and Property lists, folded by default) and the asset detail sheet.
ui/tabs/bag/bag.js: Composes the Bag tab: Purse with party load and Assets side by side when wide, then the Items card.
ui/tabs/bag/item-grid.js: Builds the Items card: find box, filter chips and the grid of item tiles (rarity, quantity, wearer, new and torn marks).
ui/tabs/bag/item-sheet.js: Builds the item sheet body: tile, rarity and kind chips, details, and the Wear on / Take off / Give to / Use on / Drop actions.
ui/tabs/bag/purse-load.js: Builds the Purse card (coins, this turn's changes, edit money) with the party load bar and its source chips.
ui/tabs/bag/rates-sheet.js: Builds the Prices here sheet body: the going rates for this place and the note on how they are worked out.
ui/tabs/fight/actions.js: Builds the acting member's panel (resources, stance switch, action tiles by kind, Back, Auto, Discard) and the after-exchange panel.
ui/tabs/fight/end.js: Builds the offer card that starts a fight and the won, fled or lost card that ends it.
ui/tabs/fight/fight.js: Composes the Fight tab from a fight view-model: header, then the offer, board (foes, party, actions, log) or end by state.
ui/tabs/fight/foes.js: Builds the Foes card: foe groups by tier with member health, a one-line fold per group, and target buttons while picking.
ui/tabs/fight/log.js: Builds the exchange log card: turn order, the latest exchange open with its rolls, earlier ones folded, and what the narrator will be told.
ui/tabs/fight/party-strip.js: Builds the Party card for a fight: each member's health, Stamina and pick, folded to one row on a phone while choosing.
ui/tabs/journal/calendar.js: Builds the Calendar card: search, month grid with a month and year picker, and the picked day beside or below it.
ui/tabs/journal/coming-up.js: Builds the Coming up card: the next 30 days grouped overdue first, each row picking its day.
ui/tabs/journal/day.js: Builds the day panel for one calendar day: a past day's record, today's plan, or what is due on a later day.
ui/tabs/journal/journal.js: Composes the Journal tab: a Quests (Tasks) / Calendar switch, then that view's cards with empty cards left out.
ui/tabs/journal/quest-editor.js: Opens the quest editor in a sheet and sends the changed fields (or give up, or delete) to the port.
ui/tabs/journal/quest-sheet.js: Builds the Edit quest form (title, what it is, step, due date, reward, difficulty, and a ⋯ menu to give up or delete).
ui/tabs/journal/quests.js: Builds the Quests (Tasks when RPG is off), Leads and Closed cards with focus star and Edit button on each quest.
ui/tabs/now/here.js: Builds the Here card: people present with their feelings ring and the Scene spoiler for wants and hiding.
ui/tabs/now/now.js: Composes the Now tab in phone order: Right now, Here, This turn, You, Pinned; two columns when the container is wide.
ui/tabs/now/right-now.js: Builds the two "Right now" cards: Needs you (actions only) and Today (focus, trip, due soon, torn gear).
ui/tabs/now/this-turn.js: Builds the This reply card: what the reply changed, exceptions first, five rows then Show all, with Why on held-back lines.
ui/tabs/now/you-pinned.js: Builds the folded You card (look, position, condition) and the pinned tracker cards.
ui/tabs/party/party.js: Composes the Party tab: the row of member portraits with Invite, then the selected member's sheet.
ui/tabs/party/sheet.js: Builds one member's sheet (name, bars, doll, stats, skills) plus the stat-spend sheet and the ⋯ menu sheet.
ui/tabs/party/skills.js: Builds the Skills list (glyph, kind line, rank pill, seven-step mastery bar) and the one-skill sheet.
ui/tabs/party/slot-picker.js: Opens the Party tab's bottom sheet and fills it for one gear slot: the worn item and the Bag's matching items with Equip.
ui/tabs/party/slots.js: Builds the equipment doll: five slots each side of the portrait, one glyph per slot type, rarity edge, dashed when empty.
ui/tabs/people/dossier/death.js: Builds the Death page and card for a deceased or presumed-dead person: how, when, where, certainty, Mark alive and the reference line.
ui/tabs/people/dossier/dossier.js: Composes one person's dossier: top bar with ⋯ menu, hero, the summary cards, and the paged detail views, with Escape through the back-stack.
ui/tabs/people/dossier/feelings.js: Draws the dossier hero ring with its four corner numbers and builds the "With you" page (meters, stage, changes).
ui/tabs/people/dossier/now-page.js: Builds the Right now page (where, doing, wearing, thinking, or last seen) with the shared scene-spoiler switch, and the Mood page.
ui/tabs/people/dossier/past-secrets.js: Builds the Ties, Past and Secrets pages of a dossier (opened secrets stay readable after a death; locked ones show only their rule).
ui/tabs/people/dossier/profile.js: Builds the Profile page: who they are, looks, character (personality, speech, habits) and background; unknown gender is flagged.
ui/tabs/people/map.js: Draws People > Map: everyone known placed around you by a feeling lens, tie lines between them and a card for the picked person.
ui/tabs/people/people.js: Composes the People tab: header with List/Map switch, search, filters, the Here / Elsewhere / Deceased lists, or the cast map.
ui/tabs/people/person-card.js: Builds one person tile for the People list (feelings ring, mood, where or last seen, last said) and the portrait disc the map reuses.
ui/tabs/story/agendas.js: Builds the Agendas card: off-screen plans closest to you first, five then Show all, with the told-this-reply tag.
ui/tabs/story/director.js: Builds the Director cards (plan bar, pulse, cast, arc, beats, clocks, hooks, news on its way) and the shared plan-gated card.
ui/tabs/story/ripples-secrets.js: Builds the Secrets card (one list, with dossier links) and the Ripples card (sway bars of named powers).
ui/tabs/story/story.js: Composes the Story tab: a Director / Trackers switch, the plan bar and the Director cards or the Trackers view.
ui/tabs/story/trackers.js: Builds the Trackers view: one card per tracker with bars, numbers or text, Show on Now and Edit.
ui/tabs/world/factions.js: Builds the Factions card: each known faction with its stance, summary, area, known members and latest event.
ui/tabs/world/map.js: Builds the map card: find, region, zoom, fit, centre and tidy tools over a pan-and-pinch SVG of places, roads and the trip line.
ui/tabs/world/news.js: Builds the News card: events the character has heard, with a state filter, heard-where-and-from lines and place and faction links.
ui/tabs/world/place-sheet.js: Builds the place sheet: kind, region, danger, distance from you, news, quests and people for one map place.
ui/tabs/world/trip.js: Builds the trip card and one-line trip summary, and words travel times (8-hour travel days, no half-day rounding).
ui/tabs/world/world.js: Composes the World tab: a Map / News / Factions switch over one body, the place sheet, and links between the views.
ui/theme/apply.js: Writes a token set on the suite root and refuses values that are not colour, length or font.
ui/theme/follow-st.js: Maps SillyTavern's theme variables to tokens and decides light or dark.
ui/theme/sky.js: Time-of-day backdrop gradient (pack art replaces it).
ui/theme/tokens.js: Token names and the Glass dark and light values.
scripts/play/git.mjs: Runs git commands for the play build, with an optional private index file.
scripts/play/dist.mjs: Builds the one installable play extension from a commit: bundles the four tools at their installed depth, copies assets, writes root files and commits to the local play branch.
scripts/play/dist-sets.mjs: Says what the play extension contains: the four bundled tools, their asset roots and the root manifest, entry and stylesheet.
scripts/play/dist-assets.mjs: Copies the CSS, fonts and images the play bundles reach by URL next to their bundle.
scripts/play/dist-git.mjs: Extracts a commit's source tree and commits the built play folder as a child of the previous build.
scripts/codemap/root-jobs.mjs: Finds job sentences for files under the source roots from package dev-map bullets and opening comments.
scripts/layout.mjs: Loads scripts/layout.json and answers which repo paths sit under a package root or a source root.
tests/scripts/layout.test.js: Tests the layout file, the layout-driven codemap and size scripts on today's tree.
